data.name: Fadoolah
data.gender_notes: Fadoolah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah, a worshiper. The name Fadoolah carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadoolah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is deeply connected to God and seeks to fulfill His will
data.etymology: Fadoolah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadoolah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فاضلى
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفاضل من الفضائل، و الفاضليات من صفات الله تعالى. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم الفاضل لوصف الشخص الخير، أو المقدار الزائد من الخير. يُعد الفاضل أحد الأسماء الحسنى في الإسلام، و يُستخدم لوصف الشخص الذي يتمتع بأولى القيم، و الأفضلية في جميع الأشياء. يُعتبر الفاضل من الأسماء التي تُمنى لها في الإسلام، و يُعتبر من أفضل الأسماء التي يُمنى لها للولادة.

in_urdu.name: فاضلہ
in_urdu.meaning: خیر کا زیادہ، فضیلت کا مالک، بہترین چیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاضلہ کا لفظ قرآن میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے، جس میں کہا گیا ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ ہم کو خیر کی نیکیوں سے بھرنا چاہتا ہے، اور ہم کو اس کے خیر کی نیکیوں میں بڑھنا چاہتا ہے۔ فاضلہ کے الفاظ کا استعمال ہمیشہ ایسے لوگوں پر کیا جاتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا کو حاصل کرتے ہیں، اور ان کے اعمال کو اللہ تعالیٰ کا فضل ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़दूलाह
in_hindi.meaning: खीर का अधिक, मेधा का अधिक, उत्कृष्टता का अधिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़दूलाह का शब्द अरबी भाषा में एक गुणवत्ता है, जिसका अर्थ है अधिक खीर। इस शब्द का उपयोग मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक बच्चे के नाम के रूप में किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छा व्यक्ति होने का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_english.name: Fadoolah
in_english.meaning: Excess of good, excellence, goodness in excess
in_english.long_meaning: Fadoolah is an Arabic name that means excellence, goodness, and excess of good. It is derived from the Arabic root 'f-d-l', which means to increase or to make something more. In Islamic tradition, Fadoolah is considered a name of excellence and goodness, and it is often given to children born into Muslim families. The name Fadoolah is also mentioned in the Quran, where it is described as a gift from Allah to those who are obedient to Him.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fadoolah carries great significance within the Islamic community and holds cultural importance due to its reference to someone deeply devoted to Allah. It highlights the importance of faith and devotion within Islamic society. Fadoolahs are often seen as spiritual leaders and role models within the community, inspiring others to strive for a closer relationship with Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fadoolah signifies a person who is dedicated and committed to his or her faith. It represents a journey towards seeking knowledge, meaning, and connectedness with Allah. The name reflects an inner state of peace and tranquility, as one’s focus is solely on pleasing and serving Allah. In essence, the name Fadoolah signifies a person who is striving for a deeper, more intimate relationship with the Divine, and serves as a reminder of the importance of this spiritual journey in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant of God" symbolizes One who is devoted to Allah, a worshiper. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fadoolah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant of god.
